children: Diamondback Energy Inc. (FANG) filed a Form 8K - Operations and Financial Condition - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on October 08, 2026.

Diamondback Energy, Inc. ("Diamondback") presents in this Item 2.02 certain information for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 regarding its realized prices, derivative activity and weighted average basic and diluted shares outstanding.
Realized Prices
Third quarter 2026 average unhedged realized prices were $87.30 per barrel of oil, $1.12 per Mcf of natural gas and $20.02 per barrel of natural gas liquids ("NGLs").
Third quarter 2026 average realized hedged prices were $85.89 per barrel of oil, $0.90 per Mcf of natural gas and $20.02 per barrel of NGLs.
Average Prices:
Oil ($ per Bbl) $ 87.30
Natural gas ($ per Mcf) $ 1.12
Natural gas liquids ($ per Bbl) $ 20.02
Oil, hedged ($ per Bbl)(1) $ 85.89
Natural gas, hedged ($ per Mcf)(1) $ 0.90
Natural gas liquids, hedged ($ per Bbl)(1) $ 20.02

(1)Hedged prices reflect the effect of our commodity derivative transactions on our average sales prices and include gains and losses on cash settlements for matured commodity derivatives, which we do not designate for hedge accounting. Hedged prices exclude gains or losses resulting from the early settlement of commodity derivative contracts.
